### Overview
During the rolling deployment of Kafka consumer services, repeated group rebalances interrupted message processing across several partitions. Consumers repeatedly left and rejoined the group as instances restarted, causing elevated processing latency, delayed commits, and a temporary reduction in throughput. Operators removed affected nodes from rotation, installed the renewed certificate, and validated the chain with external probes before restoring traffic. Failover to healthy nodes limited impact, with capacity monitored for overload. We added per-node expiry checks, end-to-end TLS probes, and deployment gates verifying active-listener fingerprints.
